title: Cyprus Work Permit Pakistan — Requirements, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: Cyprus work permit / work visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: How to get a Cyprus work permit from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: You typically need a genuine Cyprus job offer/authorization, then a complete national visa file. SK Immigration prepares the Pakistan-side documents from PKR 80,000; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Cyprus work visa?
faqs.answer: Passport, contract/authorization, CV, certificates, and any medical/police documents requested. Exact lists vary — we build a checklist for your case.

faqs.question: SK Immigration Cyprus work fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000 for preparation support. Official fees are separate. No guarantees.

faqs.question: Do I need local language for Cyprus?
faqs.answer: Often helpful; some international roles use English. We assess language before you invest.

faqs.question: Can I convert a visit visa to work in Cyprus?
faqs.answer: Not as a DIY loophole. Work needs the correct authorization. We advise legal routes only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Immigration authorities decide every application.
